headline: Marriott Lifts Annual Room Revenue Growth Forecast on Resilient Travel Demand
summary: Marriott International raised its annual room revenue growth forecast, supported by resilient ongoing travel demand.
why: Marriott is the world's largest hotel chain, making its forward-looking revenue guidance a bellwether for global consumer discretionary spending and hospitality.

impacts.name: Marriott International
impacts.why: Upgraded full-year room revenue growth forecast based on robust travel trends.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Upgraded annual guidance signals sustained consumer appetite for hospitality services.
